question: In India, the ______ may create and dissolve any of the union territories, whose powers are more limited than those of the states.
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Union Government**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In India, the Union Government has the power to create and dissolve union territories.**
 
• Union territories are **administrative divisions of India that are governed by the Union Government, either in part or in whole.**
 
• Their** powers are more limited than those of the states, which are self-governing and have their own governments. **
 
• The Union Government also has the power to: create new states, combine states, change state boundaries, and terminate a state's existence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Justice of India**

 
 
• **The Chief Justice of India is the head and chief judge of the Supreme Court of India.**
 
• The Chief Justice has administrative power over the Supreme Court and its Registry, which is the administrative wing of the court.
 
• The Chief Justice also acts as the president of India if the offices of both the president and vice president are vacant. 
 
 
 
• **President**
 
 
• The **President of India is the head of state and commander-in-chief of the Indian Armed Forces.**
 
• The President's Secretariat assists the President in carrying out their constitutional, ceremonial, and other state responsibilities. 
 
 
 
• **State Governmen**t
 
 
• The Chief Secretary leads the State Government to the state government.
